text: SF is limited, but concentrations appear to be relatively low. When given with cilastatin about 70% of an intrave- nous dose of imipenem is recovered unchanged in the urine within 10 hours. A total of 50% of an intramus- cular dose is recovered in the urine and urinary concen- trations above 10 micrograms/mL are maintained for 12 hours after a dose of 500 or 750 mg. Cilastatin is also excreted mainly in the urine, the majority as un- changed drug and about 12% as N-acetyl cilastatin. Both imipenem and cilastatin are removed by haemo- dialysis.
